scripts.push: echo "its imports reach packages/ beside it, which a pushed folder can't: stage it (pnpm stage knitoutjs --state <its .pushwork>, from the repo's root), then pushwork sync in stage/knitoutjs" && exit 1
scripts.vendor: echo 'export {format} from "prettier/standalone"; export * as babel from "prettier/plugins/babel"; export * as estree from "prettier/plugins/estree"' | esbuild --bundle --minify --format=esm --outfile=core/vendor/prettier.js --legal-comments=inline --banner:js="// MIT, James Long and contributors: prettier, with its babel and estree plugins. vendored by pnpm vendor in packages/knitoutjs from its devDependencies, as it is not in patchwork's importmap"
